name: data
description: Databricks notebooks and Python packages for OpenJII

scripts.install: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv sync --frozen || uv sync; else echo 'uv not found, skipping python env sync'; fi
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.test: export CLICKHOUSE_TEST_PORT=8125; trap 'pnpm run test:teardown' EXIT; pnpm run test:setup && uv run --env-file ../../packages/database/.env.test pytest
scripts.clean: git clean -xdf .cache .turbo .venv dist src/lib/*/dist src/lib/*/build src/lib/*/*.egg-info
